entities.summary: Ozora Pierson Stearns was an American politician and attorney. A member of the Republican Party, he served as a U.S. Senator from the state of Minnesota. Prior to his election to the Senate, he served as mayor of Rochester, Minnesota, and county attorney of Olmsted County. He was a Colonel in the Union Army during the American Civil War.
